description.value: Stage is a wine bar and restaurant in Victoria's Fernwood neighbourhood, known for a seasonally rotating menu built around ingredients sourced directly from local farmers and purveyors. The room accommodates private and semi-private events up to 90 guests, and Sunday evenings feature a family-style three-course dinner. A touring cyclist stopping in Fernwood will find a relaxed neighbourhood spot with a full evening menu and happy hour service.
